cohort: A single 31-year-old pregnant Afghan woman at 34 weeks of gestation who presented with decreased fetal movement, and her newborn.
finding: Prenatal imaging identified fetal cerebral sinovenous thrombosis with subacute intracranial hemorrhage, and the newborn, despite requiring an emergency cesarean section, remained clinically stable with no neurological deficits at 4-month follow-up after enoxaparin therapy.
mod_finding: An emergency cesarean section was performed at 36 weeks due to fetal distress.
